permits.description: mechanical and electrical and t-24. deferred submittal on orig permit 201912099017.
1st & 2nd - fire sprinklers; relocate 25 pendent sprinklers on the 1st fl. relocate 1 upright sprinkler on the 2nd fl. ref pa 2019-1209-9017
demo and construction of non structural partions, new doors, frames and millwork, mep sprinkler life safety under seperate permit
install fire alarm communication unit to monitor fire sprinkler system under pa 201810123127 per sffd ab4-11 sprinkler waterflow and supervisory system per nfpa 72-2016 section 23.8.5.5.1
revised bathroom locations. revision to 201804196766 maher nma

install new fire sprinkler and fire underground system per nfpa13 throughout the building. total of 79heads, demand is 435 gpm @ 61 psi plus 250 gpm hose, 4" copper ug connecting to 6" @ tehama. ref 201804196766. maher n/a. ref pa 201804196766.

rev to pa# 201804196766; voluntary retrofit to interior of existing concret walls by addition of shotcrete to interior selected existing concrete walls in order to add vertical & lateral load resistance of existing structure n/a maher

change of use. conversion of (e)pdr zoned bldg of <5000 sq ft to(n) offices of approx 7268 sq ft.add 2(n)kitchenettes and glass walls at atrivar. (e)fire sprinklers to be configured as require under sep permit. core & shell under 201804196766.maher n/a.

existing industrial space: rebuild floors as noted in plans,construct new accesible bathrooms, add platform lift. demo floor between first and second floor. remove (e) skylight, replace w/ (n) skylight. full sprinkler system under seperate permit. no change in use, replace garage doors, restore all
replace damaged skylight dormer (6), repair minor dryrot in framing, same for same, skylight max u-factor = 0.77.
reroofing - apply spray foam roofing (polyurethane) to 5,500 sq. ft. comply with complaint #201326401.
(e) property line windows & garage door openings at rear bldg wall to be closed. opening infill to be constructed as 2-hr rated wall.

alter (e) bldg to make it code, compliant on its newly subdivided lot.(e) openings @rear property line will be blocked up & a new interior stair will replace a non-conforming stair to provide 2nd means egress from 2/f. a new corridor connect to egress door will complete 2nd mean egress
